metadata.title: Brutus-Pell Square-Rank Relation
metadata.description: An explicit Pell rank-of-apparition family derived from classical prime-power lifting. The note isolates z_P(21^k)=4*21^(k-1) for k>=2 and the square-rank subfamily z_P(21^(2r+1))=(2*21^r)^2, while explicitly distinguishing the specialization from the classical general theory.
metadata.notes: Bibliographic novelty is not claimed for the general Lucas-sequence lifting theorem. This record is intended as an explicit specialized note and reproducibility package.
